verdict.rationale: Superpowers isolates code work in auto-created git worktrees so parallel tasks don't clobber each other (docs-10, docs-45). It also halts for a human before destructive or irreversible actions (docs-2) and refuses to force-remove worktrees with uncommitted work (docs-4). This is workspace isolation, not a sandbox environment. The runtime probe shows skills run with full agent permissions, so nothing shields production data. Missing for 10: an actual sandboxed execution or test environment, separation from production data or services, and independent or hands-on corroboration of safe testing.
